scope: Trend Following school ONLY — no hybrid router selection across schools, no other schools, one school's engine alone took every decision (brief section 5)

strategy.config_yaml:
trend_following:
  enabled: true
  timeframe: M15
  ema_period: 21
  donchian_period: 20
  min_adx: 22.0
  atr_stop_mult: 2.0
  pullback_lookback: 5
  pullback_ema_proximity_atr: 0.5
  trailing_atr_mult: 2.0
  break_even_at_r: 1.0
  valid_minutes: 60

config_policy: production defaults FROZEN — no parameter optimization; walk-forward measures stability of the frozen config only

data_source.name: HistData.com — Generic ASCII 1-minute bar quotes (Bid), XAUUSD

backtest_engine: HybridRuntime (app/bootstrap.py) via VirtualClock + HistoricalProvider — the REAL production runtime; decisions only on M15 closes; entries fill at decision close + adverse slippage
intrabar_rule: conservative synthetic ticks [O,L,H,L,C] — SL side always checked before TP side; SL gap fills at first available price
no_lookahead: provider serves bars strictly with close_time <= virtual now; strategy consumes closed bars only (closed_bars as_of)

cost_scenarios.note: synthetic sensitivity band around the documented research assumption — HistData source is Bid-only so the historical true spread is unknowable from this data; commission marked INCOMPLETE (experimental default)

success_criterion: correct executed test with trustworthy results — positive or negative (brief section 16); profit was NOT the success bar
